testcase.name: a SIGTERM to ./erp verify ends every stage process it started (the e2e loop, docker run, tee, sed, the load sampler)
stop_process_trees ends a process, its children and grandchildren, and nothing else
a run busy only in the middle is not judged quiet (critics p02 r8, p03 r8, p01 r10: load 0.28 at the start, 68-74 mid-run, 4.76 at the end)
a run quiet throughout and too slow fails, and one quiet throughout within the maximum passes
one busy sample anywhere makes the run busy; without samples (an older ./erp) the start and end readings decide as before
samples that cannot be read do not make a run quiet: an empty or broken sample file is judged busy only by its readings, never skipped silently
